title: Dev pb with Dana smb and tbr
symptom: In some cases, an error message about wrong TBR value appears in the loop page. When this occurs, if a SMB is scheduled, it will not be sent to the pump until the TBR value becomes correct. The problem fixes itself later during the rise, but reappears when glucose becomes stable. The issue occurs with Dana RS, not with Dana-i or Dash.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. MilosKozak initially suspected a pump driver issue, but later stated that the TBR setting really failed as reported by the pump, and suggested updating the pump firmware. No definitive cause is confirmed.
fix: MilosKozak suggested updating the pump firmware using the AnyDana upgrade kit, and later referenced a commit (0dbfa6182f996674c3ab72aa1fc19684d8cc00ae) that hopefully resolves the issue. No specific configuration change is stated.
evidence_quote: this time setting of TBR really failed (reported by pump) as this usually works, i'd try update the firmware in pump
